svg.title: Known-best packing of 211 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=211 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the free grid slack closed and the near-axis squares straightened at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete c3d17ab rational centre/half-angle certificate in the source's sqcert format, centres in [0, S]^2, read from the retained file at the pin. Finite construction feasibility only; no local minimum, KKT, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=211 regularized: side ~ 14.99633672 (certified upper bound)
